suggestions.suggestion:
[CM-ENTRY] <b> is not a permitted child of <entry> per the DITA 2.0 DTD. Permitted children: dl div fig image lines lq note object ol p pre sl ul boolean cite keyword ph q term text tm xref state data data-about foreign unknown draft-comment fn indextermref indexterm required-cleanup..
`<b>`, `<i>`, and `<codeph>` are valid DITA 1.3 elements but not permitted in DITA 2.0.
They have been retained as-is. If targeting DITA 2.0, replace:
  `<b>` → `<ph outputclass="bold">your text</ph>`
  `<i>` → `<ph outputclass="italic">your text</ph>`
  `<codeph>` → `<ph outputclass="code">your text</ph>`

suggestions.issue: Error: Attribute "navtitle" on <mapref> is not permitted in a DITA 2.0 map document.
suggestions.suggestion:
Error: Attribute "navtitle" on <mapref> is not permitted in a DITA 2.0 map document..
`<mapref>` is not permitted as a direct child of `<map>` in DITA 2.0.
Replace `<mapref href="sub.ditamap"/>` with `<topicref href="sub.ditamap" format="ditamap"/>`.
Example: `<topicref href="alarms.ditamap" format="ditamap"/>`

suggestions.issue: table 1 row has 3 entries but cols=5
suggestions.suggestion:
table 1 row has 3 entries but cols=5.
Update the `cols` attribute on `<tgroup>` to match the actual number of column entries in each row: `<tgroup cols="3">`.
Also check that every row has the same number of `<entry>` elements.

suggestions.issue: <shortdesc> element is missing — required for search previews and navigation
suggestions.suggestion:
<shortdesc> element is missing — required for search previews and navigation.
Add a `<shortdesc>` element immediately after the `<title>` element. Write 1–2 sentences (max 30 words) summarising the topic purpose. Avoid generic openers like 'This topic describes...'.

suggestions.issue: <prolog> element is missing — AI (Layer 3) should have added prolog with keywords and indexterms
suggestions.suggestion:
<prolog> element is missing — AI (Layer 3) should have added prolog with keywords and indexterms.
Add a `<prolog>` element after `<shortdesc>` (or after `<title>` if shortdesc is absent) containing metadata and keywords:
`<prolog><metadata><keywords><keyword>term</keyword></keywords></metadata></prolog>`
